text_block_list.text:
One evening, just before
the Satsuki Sho, the first race of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh-kuh...
Let us begin, then—Act One of this three-act play.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The Satsuki Sho! Destroy everything,
and simply gaze up at my Hanging Gardens!"
Tanino Gimlet, one of the top favorites, delivered a flashy speech on a TV broadcast, but—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha-ha! Riding high, are we, 
Lord Gimlet? Completely unaware of my schemes!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Sing, dance, and rage while you still can!
Before you know it, you'll be plummeting straight down the cliff~~!

"No Reason smiled complacently while
watching the TV broadcast, but..."

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's take a look at the Umamusume
scheduled to run in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
No less than nine graded race winners
have lined up their names.
This looks to be quite the star-studded lineup...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mmh?
"Am I seeing things? I thought I didn't see No Reason's name anywhere..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I sense an ill omen...
Trainer, send forth a scout at once!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Why wasn't my name on the list?
I have a bad feeling about this...
(Brrrr... *click*)

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Um, No Reason's race registration...
hasn't been accepted.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
"If you truly did submit it,
there might have been some kind of glitch.
There's only 30 minutes left until the deadline, though..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaat~?!
Oh no, this is a disaster!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, ask questions later!
Prepare the documents for resubmission immediately!!

While apologizing, I distinctly remembered submitting
the paperwork. What suddenly came to mind was—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It looks like this year is going to be quite an ordeal for No Reason-san...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What I see is... the number "3."
It feels like all sorts of misfortune related to 3
is going to happen...

—Matikanefukukitaru's fortune.
She said various misfortunes might arise surrounding the Classic Triple Crown, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Runneth! Run, run, ruuuuun~~!!
Dash swiftly, Trainer!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It will not do for me to go alone. Unless you, my Trainer, submit it, they will not accept it!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Gallop a thousand leagues in a single breath~!
Holding the documents, I desperately pedaled my bicycle. And then—
(Ding dong dang dooon♪)

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is it closing time already?
Hey someone, go lock the front doors.
(Screeech...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nwoooooh, as if I'd let youuuuu~~!!
(SKRRRRRT!!)
Just in the nick of time, No Reason slips through the closing door and dives inside.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member B
text_block_list.text: And you are...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Those far off, hear my roar!
'Tis I, the Umamusume destined to overthrow the mighty—
No Reason!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
O ye who shall roar your name across the world at the upcoming Satsuki Sho!
Hold, hold, hold that deadline right there!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member B
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me to wait...
Um... what about the documents...?

Gasping for breath and nearly collapsing,
they managed to hand it over somehow.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Phew, made it just in time, did we...?
Well done, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Just as Fukukitaru-dono said,
this year appears to be full of twists and turns.
It won't be straightforward...
(SLAM!)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oho! The Trainer hath fallen!

I'm alive. But... I don't even have the energy to make a witty comeback.
It was close, but somehow I made it through the first misfortune.
And then—the day of the event.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"So in the end, it seems the mistake on the documents
was not your fault after all."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You have done well... to pass the baton.
Your sacrifice shall not be in vain...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, just a joke, just a joke.
Regardless, I must reward you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely.
Today... I feel like I can see an auspicious sign...!

"To shock the world at this Satsuki Sho,
she laid low without targeting any major races,
diligently honing her skills."
"After that, if No Reason launches a surprise attack at the perfect moment—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, hear ye, for I am No Reason!
The warlord who shall unite the realm!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Lord Gimlet, never let your guard down, not even for a moment~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha, what a funny Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the Classic Triple Crown is a big festival,
so you definitely need an Umamusume like this around!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Hah, a warlord from the East, are you? Come to take the snake woman's head? But—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Today is a gathering of gods.
There is no one here who would intertwine fates with the likes of you.
Fuhaha.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu, ignored as expected, are we?
Very well, that merely proves they have lowered their guard.)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(Now, let the greatest upset of a lifetime begin!
I'll flip everything right upside down from the very bottom!)
